faq_booking_question: How do I book a certification test?
faq_remote_question: Can I take the test from home?
faq_cancel_question: What happens if I need to cancel?
faq_booking_answer: You can book the test through our website under “My Pages” or by contacting us via email.
faq_remote_answer: Yes, you can choose to take the test remotely. You need a stable internet connection, a webcam, and a microphone.
faq_cancel_answer: You can cancel via My Pages or by contacting Scandinavian Certification Services by phone.
faq_storage_question: How do I store my personal belongings?
faq_storage_answer: We provide lockers with keys when you arrive.
faq_notes_question: Should I bring a notepad and pen?
faq_notes_answer: No, we provide these if your certification allows the use of pen and paper.
faq_computer_question: Do I need to bring my own computer?
faq_computer_answer: No, we have a computer room where the certification tests are taken.
faq_food_question: May I bring food or drinks into the test room?
faq_food_answer: No, but if you have a longer exam with scheduled breaks, you may place food and drinks in our lounge so you can access them during your break.
faq_arrival_answer: No later than 30 minutes before your scheduled time.
faq_id_question: Do I need two forms of ID?
faq_id_answer: Your confirmation will state whether you need both a primary and a secondary ID. If the exam requires a secondary ID (not all do), a payment card with your full name and handwritten signature is sufficient as the second ID.
faq_parking_answer: Yes, there are plenty of parking spaces. (Applies to the Johanneshov test center.)
faq_support_question: Who can I turn to during the certification if I have questions?
faq_support_answer: An administrator is available throughout the entire certification to help you with technical or practical questions — whether you are taking the test online or on site.
faq_malmo_info_heading: Do you have questions about taking your test on site in Malmö?
faq_malmo_info_body: Lexicon handles these directly. Contact certifiering@lexicon.se for information about facilities, equipment, schedules, and practical details.
title: How the certification tests work
intro: At Scandinavian Certification Services, certification tests are conducted digitally via Certiport’s platform. You can choose to take the test from home or on-site at our test center in Malmö.
paragraph1: The tests are time-controlled and take place entirely online. You log in through Certiport’s system using a personal login provided at the time of booking. A booking confirmation will be sent to your email a few days before the test date.
paragraph2: Each certification includes a set number of questions and a fixed time limit. Your results are displayed immediately after completing the test.
paragraph3: For remote exams, you need a stable internet connection, a webcam, a microphone, and a quiet environment free from distractions.

accessibilityTitle: Accessibility Statement for Scandinavian Certification Services
accessibilityAboutText: This website is operated by Scandinavian Certification Services. We want as many people as possible to be able to use our website, regardless of ability, and we continuously work to improve accessibility in accordance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.
accessibilityHowAccessibleText: We are aware that parts of the website are not fully accessible, but we are actively working to address these issues.
accessibilityImprovementsPlannedTitle: Examples of areas we plan to improve:
accessibilityImprovementContrast: Color contrast in certain parts of the interface.
accessibilityImprovementAltText: Alternative text (alt text) for all images.
accessibilityImprovementFocus: Clearer focus indicators for keyboard navigation.
accessibilityImprovementAria: Improved support for screen readers and ARIA labels.
accessibilityComplianceText: The website largely follows the WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines. We have conducted manual and automated tests to identify accessibility issues, and improvements are made continuously as part of our development cycles.
accessibilityReportText: If you discover problems not listed here, or if you believe we are not meeting accessibility requirements, you can contact us:
accessibilityReportThanks: We appreciate all feedback that helps us make the website more accessible.
accessibilityOversightText: If you are not satisfied with how we handle your feedback, you can contact:
accessibilityOversightAgency: The Swedish Agency for Digital Government (DIGG)
accessibilityTechBuiltWith: The website is built using modern web technologies:
accessibilityPlanWcag: Implementation of full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
accessibilityPlanAutoTesting: Automated contrast and accessibility testing for every release.
accessibilityPlanBookingSupport: Improved accessibility support in the booking flow and user accounts.
accessibilityPlanTraining: Training developers in universal design and accessibility principles.
accessibilityClosing: We strive to ensure that all users — regardless of ability — can book certifications and use our services easily, safely, and accessibly.

categories.unity_certified_user_programm: The Unity Certified User Programmer exam validates foundational skills in C# programming within the Unity environment. Candidates demonstrate their ability to create interactivity in games, applications, AR/VR, and other experiences. This entry‑level certification covers essential competencies such as debugging, problem‑solving, interpreting APIs, writing and evaluating code, and navigating the Unity interface. To be well prepared, candidates are expected to have completed at least 150 hours of Unity training before the exam.
categories.unity_certified_user_vr.descr: This certification exam assesses the fundamental skills required to build VR simulations in Unity. It confirms the candidate’s ability to design and develop interactive VR experiences and applications within the Unity environment.
categories.unity_certified_user_design.d: This certification validates foundational skills in digital creation and visual design within Unity. The exam tests the candidate’s ability to work with 2D and 3D assets, use materials and textures, lighting and effects, and create user interfaces and visual compositions. It demonstrates the ability to produce interactive and visually appealing experiences in games, applications, and AR/VR environments. At least 150 hours of Unity training is recommended for proper preparation.
privacy_intro: At Scandinavian Certification Services (SCS), we value your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in connection with certification bookings and test administration.
privacy_data_collected_1: Name, email address, and contact details during registration and login.
privacy_data_collected_3: Technical data such as IP address and cookies when using our website.
privacy_usage_1: To manage bookings and confirmations via the SCS website.
privacy_usage_2: To enable certification testing via Certiport’s platform.
privacy_usage_3: To communicate with you about bookings, changes, or technical issues.
privacy_usage_4: To improve our services and user experience.
privacy_sharing_text: Your booking information is shared with Certiport, as the test itself is conducted on their platform. Certiport processes this data according to their own privacy policy. We never sell your data to third parties.
privacy_legal_1: Processing is necessary to fulfill the agreement (booking and certification).
privacy_legal_2: Some data is processed to meet legal obligations (e.g., accounting).
privacy_storage_title: How long we store your data
privacy_storage_text: Personal data is stored as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose of the booking and certification. After that, the data is deleted or anonymized.
privacy_security_text: We use technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
privacy_rights_1: Request access to your personal data.
privacy_rights_4: Submit a complaint to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).
